claims.claim: Q2 2026 sales were $8.8B, up 55% reported and 30% organically, with $10.7B orders and 1.23:1 book-to-bill, strengthening evidence that demand is not acquisition-only.

CommScope CCS expectations were raised to about $4.6B 2026 sales and $0.30 adjusted EPS accretion from $4.1B and $0.15, while the Q2 10-Q confirms acquisition funding used notes, delayed-draw term loans and cash.

risks.risk: Acquisition financing and integration remain material despite raised accretion expectations; Q2 adjusted operating results also included an $80M net tariff-recovery benefit.

unknowns.unknown: Sources do not isolate normalized CCS integration margin or prove durable product-level pricing power.

claims.claim: Raised CCS sales/accretion expectations, 30% organic growth, record orders and $1.2B Q2 free cash flow are concrete execution evidence, while debt-funded acquisition scale increases the burden of sustained integration cash generation.

risks.risk: Raised acquisition expectations can reverse if integration costs, customer attrition, leverage or demand normalization emerge.

unknowns.unknown: No distinct authorized live valuation observation was acquired in this assist; valuation remains Alpha-owned.
